sqlReaderQuery.value:
@if(
    equals(toLower(pipeline().parameters.reload_flag), 'no'),
    concat('SELECT * FROM fwk_meta.GetMetadataDetails(', 
           string(pipeline().parameters.ModuleID), 
           ') WHERE batch_id = ', 
           string(pipeline().parameters.batch_id)),
	if(
		equals(toLower(pipeline().parameters.reload_flag), 'yes'),
    concat('SELECT * FROM fwk_meta.GetMetadataDetails(', 
           string(pipeline().parameters.ModuleID), 
           ') WHERE source_object IN (', 
           string(pipeline().parameters.reload_tables), 
           ')'),
		   'Invalid reload_flag value'
	)
)
